title: Official I-032 fan-out and iteration limits are refused at plan construction
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: device_scheduler_test.dart officializes PLAN_CYCLE, paid-execution subset, protocol version, closed schema, placement, and in-memory expiry/cancel/late-result fences, but never asserts PLAN_FANOUT or PLAN_LIMIT. harness_transactions_test.dart officializes one-session durable DAG and late/cancel LEASE_FENCED. harness_takeover_test.dart officializes takeover idempotency, quarantine, and restart of an old device, not compile-time fan-out or iteration caps. Those files were not reused, weakened, or rewritten.
